name: DiBa VUS
description: VUS (Validació d'Usuaris) integration for DiBa sites: authenticate/auto-provision Drupal users against the DiBa corporate VUS web service and Oracle mailbox directory, with login integration and admin reports.
project_description: Submodule of DiBa Integration that authenticates Drupal users against the Diputació de Barcelona VUS (Validació d'Usuaris) corporate service. It validates credentials through the VUS web service (HTTP form-POST, XML response) and, optionally, auto-creates Drupal accounts and synchronizes name/ens/perfils into taxonomy vocabularies. A separate Oracle (oci8) connection reads the corporate mailbox directory to power admin busties (mailbox), statistics and mismatch-error reports. Login-form, user-form and password-reset flows are adapted per validation mode, and a StackMiddleware performs post-login redirects for the POST single-sign-on path.
